description: Source file implementing Vulkan pipeline utility functions, classes for pipeline layout, compute pipeline, and pipeline cache management within the ATen native Vulkan API.

classes.name: PipelineLayout
classes.description: Represents a Vulkan pipeline layout, managing descriptor set layouts and push constants.

classes.name: ComputePipeline
classes.description: Encapsulates a Vulkan compute pipeline, including creation and destruction.

classes.name: PipelineLayoutCache
classes.description: Caches Vulkan pipeline layouts for reuse, keyed by descriptor set layouts.

classes.name: ComputePipelineCache
classes.description: Caches Vulkan compute pipelines for reuse, managed with a pipeline cache object.

methods.name: vk_access
methods.description: Determines Vulkan access flags based on pipeline stage and memory access type.

methods.name: vk_stage
methods.description: Returns Vulkan pipeline stage flags based on provided stage flags.

methods.name: vk_layout
methods.description: Determines Vulkan image layout based on pipeline stage and memory access type.

methods.name: PipelineLayout::PipelineLayout
methods.description: Constructor that creates a Vulkan pipeline layout with specified descriptor set layout.

methods.name: PipelineLayout::~PipelineLayout
methods.description: Destructor that destroys the Vulkan pipeline layout.

methods.name: ComputePipeline::ComputePipeline
methods.description: Constructor that creates a Vulkan compute pipeline with given shader module and local work group size.

methods.name: ComputePipeline::~ComputePipeline
methods.description: Destructor that destroys the Vulkan compute pipeline.

methods.name: PipelineLayoutCache::retrieve
methods.description: Retrieves a pipeline layout handle from cache or creates a new one if not present.

methods.name: ComputePipelineCache::retrieve
methods.description: Retrieves a compute pipeline handle from cache or creates a new one if not present.
